name: perm_find
description: Files/dirs under a path selected by permission bits or owner: exact octal mode, world-writable, suid, sgid, exec

mode.description: exact octal permission bits to match ('777', '4755')

suid.description: only entries with the suid bit

sgid.description: only entries with the sgid bit

executable.description: only entries with any execute bit

owner.description: only entries owned by this user name

include_hidden.description: also scan dot-files and dot-dirs (default false)
